newsitem.title: JAPAN: G7 meeting to discuss forex stability -- MOF's Ogawa.
newsitem.headline: G7 meeting to discuss forex stability -- MOF's Ogawa.

text.p: Japan will discuss the stability of foreign exchange rates at the Group of Seven (G7) meeting to be held this weekend, Tadashi Ogawa, Japan's vice finance minister, said on Monday.
"We will hold discussions with the relevant nations aimed at achieving stability of foreign exchange rates," Ogawa said at a news conference.
Ogawa said he could not state at the moment, however, what kind of consensus the G7 was likely to reach on foreign exchange issues.
He added that Japan would explain to the other G7 nations that it was seeking economic growth led by domestic demand.
Ogawa added that it was unlikely that Japan's trade surplus would reverse its long-term declining trend.
